Of or pertaining to the heaven believed in by many religions.
Synonym of celestial: of or pertaining to the heavens, the sky regarded as the realm of the sun, moon, planets, and stars.
Of or pertaining to the kingdom of God.

examples.text:
1817, Charles Phillips (author-editor), Speech in the Case of O′Mullan v. M′Korkill, The Speeches of Charles Phillips, page 131,
No doubt, you have all personally considered — no doubt, you have all personally experienced, that of all the blessings which it has pleased Providence to allow us to cultivate, there is not one which breathes a purer fragrance, or bears an heavenlier aspect than education.

glosses: Strongly or sublimely beautiful or pleasurable.

examples.text: Oh, please continue giving me a massage—it's absolutely heavenly.

So he flew down and got that acorn, and fetched it up and dropped it in, and was just tilting his head back, with the heavenliest smile on his face, when all of a sudden he was paralyzed into a listening attitude and that smile faded gradually out of his countenance like breath off’n a razor, and the queerest look of surprise took its place.
Everything is wonderful / Being here is heavenly

glosses: In a manner like that of heaven; by the influence or agency of heaven; divinely, miraculously.

examples.text: by night [she] saw that God in her armes, saying moreover unto her, that the next day, the first man she met withall, should heavenly pay her her wages.

glosses: To a degree such as to elicit great pleasure.

examples.text: Then, we taste the refried beans and the rice, and they are so heavenly delicious.

glosses: Synonym of heavenly: of or related to Heaven and the divine.

glosses: Relating to the sky or outer space, regarded as the realm of the sun, moon, planets, and stars.

examples.text: The twelve celestial signs.

glosses: Of or pertaining to the highest degree of glory.

examples.text: We are now living and obeying celestial laws that will make us candidates for celestial glory.
How will you make it through your teenage years spiritually prepared for your celestial future? How will you connect your celestial goals with your everyday life?

glosses: Extremely good, pleasant, or blissful; heavenly.

examples.text: [Reader:] A really bad coconut is soooo yukky. But a really good coconut is so celestial. [...] If you can hear the milk sloshing inside, odds are you’ve got a celestial coconut rather than a yukky one.

glosses: An inhabitant of heaven.

examples.text: For the celestials communicate by the psychic dispatch. Scriptures prove that.

glosses: A native of China.

examples.text: Three celestials died during the voyage, and, in accordance with the contract, their remains were embalmed and carried on to China.

Que pertenece o concierne a la divinidad o a un dios.

examples.text: En este trono estaba sentado Dios, de cuyo rostro salía un divino resplandor, una deidad que hazía aquel lugar de tanta grandeza, magestad y admirable poder que a todos engendraba un terrible espanto, reverençia y pavor.

El Sol, lleno de pena, ungió la cara de Faetón de un divino licor, que le defendiese de ser quemado de los ardientes rayos, que le puso en el contorno de su cabeza, y le tornó a rogar que se dejase de su demanda; mas todo sirvió de poco.

glosses: De tan alta calidad que resulta similar a o digno de un dios.

examples.text:
A éste quiero lo que puedo,
con él me voy a acostar,
luego comienzo a rezar,
hasta que dormida quedo.
Si me despierta el humor,
el olor que me provoca
me lleva a besar su boca,
que tiene un divino olor.
Doile un beso, y dos, y tres;
vuelvo otro poco a rezar;
si no puedo sosegar,
vuelvo a calentar los pies.

Como los Ángeles cantan
paz a los hombres mortales,
a Belén van los pastores
a ver quién hizo las paces. // Hallan un divino viejo,
casto y virgen, como un Ángel,
y una Niña que no tiene
catorce años cabales.
